How to play

Use arrows or WASD to move and turn. Space drops, C saves, 1 / 2 swaps, and Esc pauses.

On touch, tap to turn, drag sideways to move, or flick straight down firmly to drop.

Fill 10-cell rows upright or 10-cell columns sideways. Turn pieces rotate the board when they lock.

Earn points for locks, hard drops, slope slides, and merges. Line clears start at 500 points and pay more in cascades.
